message.rationale: The script doc states the teaching twice, in its own words: the Essence line ('Context points the word') and the Viewer restatement ('The word bank has no fixed direction — the words in front of it swing its arrow to the river's edge or to the money house. That's how the machine knows which bank you mean.'). The delivered text performs it in order: the word alone (L1), the failure state with both ghost headings (L2), the river swing (L3–L4), the reset and mirror swing (L5–L6), and the model named in one sentence (L7: 'every word is a direction, and the words before it set where it points'). The Oneness audit's Q-a and standalone (T-16/T-17) checks restated the same one thing cold from the piece alone: PASS.
message.record: Migration decision, 2026-10-26 (JOB MIGRATION-17): the message is the script doc's own essence/restatement pair, adopted verbatim in substance; no wording was invented at this migration.

message.value: Context points the word: 'bank' alone points nowhere — the words in front of it swing its direction, to the river's edge or to the money house; every word is a direction, and the words before it set where it points.
